name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 15 – Am 61
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 15b. Regrets the fact that the economic policy pursued in Brussels condemns Europe to defeat in the face of global economic competitors; notes that while sustainability is important, the way it is promoted through the Green Deal by the Commission is ruining Europe; recalls that the result of this policy is that Europeans pay three times more for electricity and five times more for natural gas than their American competitors, which prevents European companies from maintaining their global competitiveness; calls for an entirely new energy policy, in which energy sanctions must be lifted and artificially closed energy transport routes reopened;
